Corporal '''Fabel''' was a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Galactic War]]. In [[3640 BBY]], Fabel was stationed on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], where he discovered that the [[White Maw]] had hired Anomid engineers to build an [[Arc Emitter]], a device capable of disabling any equipment running off a generator. He tasked a Republic spacer to steal an Anomid diagnostic pad and recalibrate it to make the Arc Emitter target itself.
